note: Months in which each country's rates usually change. They are prompts to re-check the official source, not facts about the current law.

JM.watch: tax year starts in January; Budget Debate in March

TT.watch: Budget presented in early October; NIS rates change in the new year

GY.watch: Budget presented in the first quarter; NIS ceilings change in January

BB.watch: Budget in March; NIS ceilings change in the new year

BS.watch: Budget in late May or June for the July fiscal year

BZ.watch: Budget in March or April; Social Security wage ceilings change

LC.watch: Budget in March; NIC ceilings and income tax allowances

DM.watch: Budget in July; Social Security rate steps up each January

GD.watch: NIS rate and ceiling change in January

VC.watch: NIS rate increases from January; budget in December

AG.watch: Budget in November or December; Social Security ceilings

KN.watch: Budget in December; Social Security ceilings

KY.watch: Pension earnings cap and licence fees; Budget in the first quarter

VG.watch: Social Security and NHI ceilings change each January

TC.watch: Business licence renewals run February to April; NIB changes

AI.watch: Budget in the first quarter; GST and levy rates

MS.watch: Budget in the first quarter; income tax allowances; Social Security rate steps

VI.watch: US federal inflation adjustments are published in October or November and mirrored from January

DO.watch: Income tax brackets and social security ceilings are indexed each January

PR.watch: Income tax brackets and Social Security base change each January; budget in June

CU.watch: Mipyme tax rules and minimum wage change by decree, often in January

HT.watch: Fiscal year starts on 1 October; new tax code planned for October 2026

AW.watch: Wage and income tax tables are published in January

CW.watch: Income tax brackets and SVB ceilings are published in January

SR.watch: Income tax thresholds and the VAT rules are updated yearly

SXM.watch: Income tax tables published late; 2026 tables expected March

BON.watch: Tax Plan is presented in September; new rates apply from 1 January

STA.watch: Tax Plan is presented in September; new rates apply from 1 January

SAB.watch: Tax Plan is presented in September; new rates apply from 1 January
